outputs.name: kv_cache_k
outputs.desc: Packed FP16 K cache slice at current pos. Physical capacity S_max rows; valid-token count is tracked separately by the caller (append index); append writes exactly the rows at the append index and never reads beyond valid rows.

outputs.name: kv_cache_v
outputs.desc: Packed FP16 V cache slice at current pos. Physical capacity S_max rows; valid-token count is tracked separately by the caller (append index); append writes exactly the rows at the append index and never reads beyond valid rows.

constraints.notes: Scheduling may round the extent to physical capacity S_max; kernels must never read or write KV rows beyond the valid-token count declared by the append index.

impl.c_declaration: void kv_cache_store_f16(uint16_t *kv_cache_k, uint16_t *kv_cache_v, const float *k, const float *v, int layer, int pos, int num_kv_heads, int head_dim, int max_seq_len);

notes: Store K and V to a packed FP16 decode KV cache at the current position.
